silences.what_they_covered_instead: Le Devoir's sole headline ('Des mots qui cognent') conveys no frame from the title alone; body text reveals it covers Quebec party election slogans, a domestic story unrelated to the cluster's Brazil-US political core.

single_outlet_findings.finding: The only headline to frame the Trump-Lula exchange as Trump's failure to 'master' Brazilian political language — inverting the diplomatic story into a critique of American political literacy that no other outlet's title approaches.
Contributes a bare TV broadcast listing with zero narrative content — the only corpus item whose headline carries no framing signal of any kind.

bottom_line: At headline level the cluster's political core — the Lula-Trump call read through Brazilian elections — is visible and leads, but roughly a third of titles carry no thematic connection to it, confirming a weakly bounded cluster whose headline layer is more fragmented than the body-text analysis suggests.
